organization.name: Stalwart Labs
organization.notes: Company founded July 2019; server development started September 2021 and first public release September 2022. Incorporated US/UK. Exact current equity owners and financing history not disclosed in official About/legal/README sources searched; no inference of bootstrapping or absence of investors.

pricingTiers.name: Community
pricingTiers.notes: Community edition free; Enterprise functions and infrastructure separate.
No public Most popular or Recommended plan designation found in the source inspected; no popularity inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise (25–499 mailboxes band)
pricingTiers.notes: USD $2.40/mailbox/year for first 25–499 band; minimum 25 mailboxes => $60/year. Graduated rates on additional bands. Monthly billing exists but numeric monthly rate unverified; annual field is per-mailbox annual amount, not entire deployment.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise (100,000+ mailboxes)
pricingTiers.notes: 100,000+ mailbox quote; published lower bands use graduated annual rates, not a flat all-mailbox rate.

moats.claim: A unified protocol engine and adaptable storage architecture differentiate Stalwart technically, but standard mail protocols and young project history limit entrenched ecosystem advantage.

productReasons.claim: JMAP, IMAP, POP3 and SMTP cover modern and legacy mail clients in one product.
CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV add calendar, contact and file collaboration alongside mail.
Built-in statistical spam and phishing protections handle reputation and suspicious messages inside the mail platform.

sponsorship.notes: Official About and README identify commercial business building Community and Enterprise. No corporate donor roster found in those sources; verified business steward fallback, not customers/integrators as sponsors.

requirements.notes: Native Linux/macOS/Windows or Docker image; production pin v0.16 series. Default binary bundles normal storage backend support.
Also default for blob/search/in-memory stores, no external DB needed.

requirements.condition: Alternative main data store; recommended multi-node
requirements.notes: Requires binary compiled with corresponding backend feature and FoundationDB service.

requirements.component: S3 / MinIO or Azure Blob or filesystem
requirements.condition: Separate attachment/blob storage instead of selected data-store backend
requirements.notes: Not required for default RocksDB path.

requirements.condition: External full-text index instead of selected data-store backend
requirements.notes: No standalone search service required by default.

requirements.condition: External in-memory store instead of selected data-store backend
requirements.notes: Default RocksDB handles this role without Redis.
Native service installer available; not mandatory for native install.

requirements.component: Public domain, DNS and SMTP connectivity
requirements.notes: Production mail requires DNS identity/routing and reachable mail ports; TLS setup and ACME available.

resources.cpu: 1 core generally sufficient for low-traffic ~5-user setups
resources.memory: 1 GB generally sufficient for typical 5–10 users; ~100 MB idle footprint
resources.notes: Sizing guidance, not hard minima. Concurrency/mail volume dominate. No fixed disk capacity published; provision for mailbox data. Default 8192 concurrent connections configurable.

selfHosting.notes: Verified explicit single-node RocksDB default; structured data/blob/search/in-memory stores independently configurable. Redis, SQL, object storage and external search are alternatives rather than universal prerequisites. External auth/AI services optional; Enterprise AI features are not required by Community. Native installer distinct from Docker.

options.name: Stalwart Linux/macOS installer
options.notes: Download official install.sh then execute with sudo; documentation separates download and execution for inspection. Classified command-line installer, not true one-click.

oneClickInstall.notes: First-party shell installer is an automated command-line path, not a graphical one-click cloud deployment. DNS, TLS and storage setup still required.
